description.en: An exploratory projection of asserted named classes, declared property endpoints and URI subclass edges. It does not encode all restrictions, disjointness, SHACL or SQL policies.

An immutable dated information record assigning a status code under a stated scheme to one delivery work item, optionally qualified by one product version.

An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes condition used in the authored acceptance contract. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.
A hypothesis specification whose constitutive claim concerns acquiring intended users or customers.
A hypothesis specification whose constitutive claim concerns adoption barriers or adoption behavior.
An authored assessment-claim artifact fixing subject, criterion, scope and the proposition under consideration.
A governed composition specification referencing offerings intended to be presented together.
A local reference artifact to an externally governed business rule. Its business-rule purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
A version-scoped specification of an intended ability, irrespective of its implementation.
An authored proposal specifying a desired change and its intended target.
A dated record describing an asserted modification to an identified product artifact or state.
A governed term definition for a planning-commitment label within a named scheme.
An authored narrative presenting scoped differentiation claims and their evidential references.
An authored semantic condition unit with a fixed proposition, applicability context and authoring provenance; distinct from a stakeholder intention, observed result or containing scenario.
A dated assessment of planning confidence with explicit subject, assessor, evidence context and scale.

An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes restriction constitutive to the authored specification. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.
An authored rule or criterion specification used to appraise product alternatives.
An immutable record of a product decision, its considered alternatives, rationale and provenance.
An immutable dated report assigning a delivery-status value to one Release.
A governed work-item artifact about intended delivery scope and its referenced functional specifications.
An authored claim that one product depends on an identified product, capability or resource under a stated dependency condition.
An authored supporting-work specification intended to enable a feature or capability specification.
An abstract category of information artifacts eligible to carry evidence in this bounded profile.
An information record documenting an assessor's attribution of one carrier to one assessment claim.
A local information record of a fixed binding to a separately governed referent, with recorded authority, provenance and constitutive purpose set.
A specification of a named feature-activation control and its intended scoping policy.
An authored functional-unit specification linking intended behavior, user value and acceptance criteria.
An authored observation or issue record with a fixed finding statement, subject bindings and provenance.
A requirement specification with an essential normative commitment about intended behavior or functionality.
A governed strategy specification linking positioning, audiences and intended market-entry activity.

An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes desired product condition. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.
An authored testable-claim artifact fixing its claim, intended scope and refutation or support conditions.
An authored model of information organization, hierarchy and navigation.
An authored plan coordinating goals, scope and expected product outcomes.
A scoped action or decision-step specification in one user-flow design.
An authored structured experience model containing scoped stage specifications.
An authored constituent stage specification owned by exactly one JourneySpecification.
A plan specification for introducing a product or change to an intended audience.
An authored scheme describing lifecycle-stage meanings applicable to products.
A scoped definition of a lifecycle stage within one lifecycle specification.
A goal specification whose constitutive desired result concerns product marketing or market introduction.

A governed local reference artifact with one canonical target and an explicitly supplied owner identifier. Its marketing-insight purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
An authored specification of audience-directed messages and supporting claims.
An authored target-condition specification marking intended planning progress.
A catalog specification of how one product is intended to be offered to an audience under stated terms.
A governed statement artifact identifying a possible value improvement in context.

An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes expected measurable product condition. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.
An authored model of a user archetype, fixing a behavioral profile, population/use context and research provenance; not a person, group of actual users or their temporary role.
A governed term definition specifying the meaning of a planning-horizon label in a named scheme.
A governed entry in one portfolio, optionally referencing a product while a broader target binding is being specified.
An authored statement specifying intended product perception for a target audience relative to alternatives.
A decision-criterion specification whose constitutive purpose is to justify or compute a planning rank.
A dated contextual ranking assessment recording a rank for a roadmap entry within a named comparison set and scale.
A dated assessment record about the proposed fit of a problem statement and a solution specification.
A governed statement artifact describing a candidate or evidenced problem.
A governed intentional product artifact with continuing constitutive purpose and stewardship lineage; not a deployment or a database row.

An actual intrinsic disposition of one concrete ProductRealization as a configured functional whole. Intended behavior, successful execution, a specification and a machine label are not the disposition.

A local reference artifact identifying a product-family target governed by an external owner. Its product-family purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
A local reference artifact identifying an externally governed product line. Its product-line purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
A dated assessment record about a product in an explicitly identified market context.

A local reference artifact binding a product measurement context to an externally governed metric. Its product-metric purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
A governed strategic arrangement organizing products, entries and planning references under a continuing portfolio mandate.

A concrete, causally integrated computing-system artifact configured to enact one fixed product-version baseline. It is the deployed functional whole, not its record, hosting machine, execution event or deployment interval.
A dated contextual assertion assigning a status value to one product.
A local reference artifact identifying an externally governed product variant. Its product-variant purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
An immutable approved specification baseline for one Product.
A requirement specification with an essential normative commitment about a measurable quality under defined conditions.
An evidence-attribution record whose constitutive assessment purpose is release.
A governed specification of a planned delivery increment and its intended contents.
An authored justification statement explaining why a requirement specification is needed.

An authored ScenarioSpecification whose constitutive content includes requirement/acceptance illustration. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.

A local provenance reference artifact identifying an origin used in deriving a requirement specification. Its requirement-source purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

An authored ConditionSpecification whose constitutive content includes required product condition. The facet belongs to this specification baseline, not to a temporary use of its file or an actual occurrence.
A governed planning-projection artifact referencing canonical product knowledge.
A scoped entry in one roadmap referencing intended initiatives, features or delivery targets.
An authored structured situation description fixing context, preconditions, ordered stimulus/action description and expected condition units; distinct from each actual occurrence.
An authored specification of included, excluded and deferred product scope.
An authored view specification with layout, interaction and state commitments.
A hypothesis specification whose constitutive claim concerns a proposed solution addressing a problem.
An authored product-level solution proposal describing how problems or opportunities are intended to be addressed.
A local reference artifact to an externally governed target market. Its target-market purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.

A local reference artifact to an externally governed segment in an identified segmentation context. Its target-segment purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
A planning record assigning a bounded target interval to one roadmap entry.

A local reference artifact identifying an externally governed implementation task. Its implementation-task purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
A ScenarioSpecification that includes an operational test procedure and expected conditions. Repeated executions reuse the specification and remain distinct events.

A local reference artifact identifying a versioned dataset used in test design or execution. Its test-data purpose is constitutive to the authored reference record, not a temporary role of the target.
A concluded attempt concerning one declared TestCase and ProductRealization. A setup-only abort does not establish actual target participation. One consolidated result documents the attempt.
The consolidated evidence record documenting one completed TestExecution.
A ScenarioSpecification describing a situation to verify specified behavior or conditions. It can be detailed enough to also be a TestCase; its described situation is not a completed TestExecution.
A governed test-organization specification containing references to test cases.
A design artifact specifying a point of contact, its channel, purpose and interaction context.
A scoped specification of a screen condition and its expected presentation or interaction.
A FindingRecord whose constitutive subject matter includes a user-flow or screen specification.
An authored sequence model of user actions, decisions and transitions.
A designed specification of a user participation context, responsibilities and permissions.
An authored user-centered narrative specifying a desired interaction goal and expected value.
An evidence-attribution record whose constitutive assessment purpose is validation.
A FindingRecord whose constitutive subject matter includes a requirement specification.
An evidence-attribution record whose constitutive assessment purpose is verification.
An authored end-to-end increment specification connecting intended value to coherent behavior and acceptance conditions.
An authored statement articulating intended product direction, experience and value.
